title: Kissed Egyptian Doraji Bowl
description: A delicate and soothing umami-rich dish combining flaky doraji, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of Egyptian spices.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sliced lemongrass, ginger, and garlic.
In a separate bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, and fennel seeds.
Cut the doraji into thin slices, using a mandoline or sharp knife.
In a large serving bowl, arrange the sliced doraji in a single layer.
Drizzle the dressing over the doraji and sprinkle with parsley.
Garnish with additional parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with warm pita bread or Egyptian flatbread for a soothing side.
To make this recipe raw-friendly, skip the cooking and use cold-pressed olive oil.
For an added crunch, sprinkle toasted pine nuts over the dish before serving.
To make this recipe vegan-friendly, substitute honey with maple syrup or agave nectar.
For a more intense flavor, marinate the doraji in the dressing for at least 30 minutes before serving.
To make this recipe gluten-free, ensure the flatbread used is made from gluten-free flours.
